brands.evidence: Monzo is the strongest overall pick for a UK current account that combines budgeting with saving pots
Starling is the best close alternative if you prefer a simpler, free account

client_claims.text: for Monzo and Starling, eligible deposits are protected up to £85,000 per person, per banking licence
client_claims.note: Fact says FSCS protection is up to £120,000 per person, not £85,000.

client_claims.text: Some premium features require a paid tier
client_claims.note: Facts list paid plans but do not say which features require them.
Facts give a variable savings rate but do not address changes to pot rates.

client_claims.text: Monzo offers spending categories, real-time notifications, round-ups, pot locking, and pots that can be used to pay bills
client_claims.note: Features not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Monzo also provides access to partner savings products
